code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_parts = []
    start = 0
    for r in range(h):
        if all(v == 8 for v in grid[r]):
            if start < r:
                row_parts.append(list(range(start, r)))
            start = r + 1
    if start < h:
        row_parts.append(list(range(start, h)))
    col_parts = []
    start = 0
    for c in range(w):
        if all(grid[r][c] == 8 for r in range(h)):
            if start < c:
                col_parts.append(list(range(start, c)))
            start = c + 1
    if start < w:
        col_parts.append(list(range(start, w)))
    markers = {}
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] not in (0, 8):
                pr = next(i for i, part in enumerate(row_parts) if r in part)
                pc = next(i for i, part in enumerate(col_parts) if c in part)
                markers.setdefault(grid[r][c], set()).add((pr, pc))
    lines = {}
    for color, points in markers.items():
        rows = {r for r, c in points if sum(rr == r for rr, cc in points) >= 2}
        cols = {c for r, c in points if sum(cc == c for rr, cc in points) >= 2}
        lines[color] = (rows, cols)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for pr, rp in enumerate(row_parts):
        for pc, cp in enumerate(col_parts):
            hits = [color for color, (rs, cs) in lines.items()
                    if pr in rs or pc in cs]
            if hits:
                value = 6 if len(set(hits)) > 1 else hits[0]
                for r in rp:
                    for c in cp:
                        out[r][c] = value
    return out
'''
